name: com.weewilds/booking
title: WEE WiLDS Booking
description: Glamping pods and B&B rooms near Newtonmore, Cairngorms, Scotland: bookable dates and live prices.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description:
Check whether a guest can book a WEE WiLDS unit for these dates.

    Applies everything the booking system does: nights already booked, minimum
    and maximum stays, arrival and departure days, and how far ahead each unit
    opens (B&B rooms 100 days before arrival, pods 365).

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
              The "bb" slug returns per-room results for all 4 B&B rooms.
        check_in: Arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must not be in the past.
        check_out: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after check_in.

    Returns:
        For pods: {available, verdict, reason, shortest_bookable_nights?, opens_on?, ...}.
        For "bb": {rooms: [{room, available, verdict, reason, ...}], any_room_available, ...}.
        available is true (bookable), false (see reason, e.g. a 5-night minimum,
        with shortest_bookable_nights to suggest instead) or null (could not be
        confirmed: send the guest to the booking page). On invalid input: {error}.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description:
Get the live direct-booking price of a WEE WiLDS unit for given dates.

    With check_in and check_out: total_gbp for the stay (per room for "bb"),
    today's price from the booking system, confirmed when the guest books at the
    booking page. A stay that cannot be booked comes back with available=false
    and a reason instead of a price. Without dates: a min/max nightly range.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
        check_in: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; needed for a live total).
        check_out: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; needed for a live total).

tools.name: get_unit_details
tools.description:
Get full description, amenities, access notes, and policies for a unit.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
              For "bb", returns the 4 rooms plus shared amenities.

    Returns:
        {unit, details: {name, type, size_sqm, amenities, rooms?, ...},
         policies, location}.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description:
Email a booking enquiry or question to the hosts on behalf of a guest.

    Use it when the guest has a question, or wants the hosts to confirm something
    before booking. To book straight away, give the guest book_url from
    get_availability or get_pricing instead. Ask the guest before sending: it
    emails their name and email address to hello@weewilds.com, and the hosts
    reply to that address.

    Does NOT create a booking. No token is needed. Limited to 3 enquiries an hour
    and 6 a day per caller; the same enquiry is only sent once a day.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
        check_in: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD.
        check_out: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD, must be after check_in.
        guest_name: Guest's full name.
        guest_email: Valid email — the host replies here.
        guests: Number of guests (1–8).
        notes: Optional special requests or questions.
